notes.title: Chernobyl: Road of Death Big Update 1.1
notes.content:
First Big Update for Chernobyl: Road Of Death - 1.1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35745026/07dd145be064b8030d39554c524a29ccc62c81ae.jpg

- Added 3 new playable characters, each with their own unique weapons and abilities-flamethrower, sniper, grenade launcher!
- Added an additional game mode - "First Snow", in which you have to survive on the location and confront the waves of enemies!
- Adjusted the game interface and prepared the basis for future updates!
- some other minor changes

[previewyoutube=xo9KvWQT6Ec;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The plans for the next big update-local multiplayer-pvp mode, and another map for single missions!

notes.title: Update to version 1.06
notes.content:
Update to version 1.06 
Made on the feedback of first players!

- improved visibility of mines, now they flicker and emit red light
- coins are attracted to the player if you approach them at a short distance that
 facilitates their gathering
- for normal difficulty added compass that indicates the location of the nearest case of documents that need to find the player

Plans for future updates: add a selection of different characters-liquidators, who will have their own abilities and differ in some kind of weapons. Also in the plans to make a new / new game modes
